_comment: Advisories accepted for the dependency audit gate (npm run security:audit). Each needs a reason and a review date; after the date it counts as unaccepted again. See docs/quality/security-checklist-wp31.md.

accepted.reason: Transitive of puppeteer (proxy-agent, get-uri). It is the FTP client for FTP proxy-auto-config URLs; the server launches Chromium for PDF export with no proxy configuration, so no FTP listing is ever parsed. Company-OS PDF export only.
Transitive of puppeteer: unzips the browser build when it is downloaded at install time, from Google's own host. Not run on any input at runtime.

Transitive of pptxgenjs: reads the dimensions of images the server itself embeds in generated presentations (Company-OS presentation export, reachable only by the platform organization; engage tenants are refused by tenantGuard).

No fixed version on npm (the fix ships from SheetJS's own site). Used only to read text from spreadsheets uploaded to Company-OS routes (HR candidates, contracts, knowledge hub), which need a platform-organization login; engage tenants are refused by tenantGuard (ADR-017) and engage imports are CSV. Replace the parser or move to the vendor build before any tenant can reach it.

Fixed only in zod 4, a breaking migration of every schema (engage ingestion, journeys, segments, copy drafts). The exposure is memory use while validating very large arrays: every engage request body is capped at 1 MB (jsonBodyParser) and ingestion batches at MAX_BATCH, so the work per request is bounded. Plan: migrate to zod 4 as its own work package.
